about_the_game:
◆ Story Overview

One day, Sakura Miko and her fellow Hololive members were transported into an alternate future timeline.
In this unfamiliar world, they encounter mysterious figures, strange phenomena, and unexpected challenges.
To return home, Miko must reunite with her scattered friends and uncover the truth hidden within this warped reality.

This is a 3D adventure game where the story unfolds through exploration, puzzle-solving, and heartfelt connections between characters.

----------------------------------------------------------

◆ Key Features

◎ Reunite and Grow Together
Step into the role of Sakura Miko and set out to find the Hololive members lost across the strange new world.
Through meaningful conversations and impactful choices, strengthen your bonds with each member, unlock their personal stories, and gradually draw closer to the world’s ultimate mystery.

◎ Exploration with the “Topic” System
Scattered across the world are special “Topic Items” that open new conversations with the members.
Bring these items to the right person to trigger unique events, deepen relationships, and reveal new sides of each character.

◎ Face Epic Boss Battles
The road home is fraught with trials, and some challenges can only be overcome through battle.
Team up with the Hololive members to take on powerful bosses and shape the outcome of your journey.

----------------------------------------------------------

This title is part of the “holo Indie” brand (※2) and developed by CCMC Co., Ltd. (※1).
It is officially approved for distribution and monetization under the holo Indie guidelines.

Please note that derivative games using COVER Corporation-owned content outside of holo Indie are not authorized for monetization.

※1. About CCMC Co., Ltd.
CCMC Co., Ltd. is officially commissioned by COVER Corporation to manage platforms (including Steam), conduct reviews, handle distribution, and oversee other necessary operations.

※2. About “holo Indie”
holo Indie is a game brand created to collaborate with fans and creators of Hololive Production.
It offers the Game Creator Support Program for derivative works.
For more information, please refer to COVER Corporation’s Derivative Works Guidelines.
